typography.accent_mono: JetBrains Mono (For small labels, numbers, tech-specs)
rules: No bold default for headings; use font-light or font-medium for a delicate editorial feel.
Numbers in manifesto should use massive display sizes (e.g., text-8xl or text-[10vw]).
Body text should be highly legible, slightly loose leading.

layouts.hero: Large kinetic hero with a signature on-load moment. Huge 'Cormorant Garamond' text revealing line-by-line via Framer Motion. Right side or overlay contains the 'Spice Garden' live voice chat demo mockup with a subtle 3D hover/parallax effect.
layouts.marquee: Slow editorial marquee of text-based logos (Spice Garden, Glow Salon, etc.) using a clean serif or sans font, separated by elegant bullet points (•). Pale background with dark earthy text.
layouts.manifesto_chapters: Numbered manifesto format for 'How it works'. Massive mono-spaced numbers (01, 02, 03) aligned left, content deep indented. Use sticky scroll effects for the chapter numbers.
layouts.use_cases: Clipped frame product photography for each usecase (Restaurants, Salons, Clinics). Images treated deliberately with a spotlight effect or passe-partout border (padded wrappers). Expandable sample chats overlaying or adjacent to the images.
layouts.features_grid: Asymmetric bento grid with delicate 1px borders (Swiss structure).
layouts.roi_calculator: Cardless, pure layout form with massive typography. Custom interactive sliders modifying large dynamic revenue numbers in real-time.
layouts.pricing: Clean vertical columns with distinct hierarchy. Monthly/6mo/Annual toggle. 'Pro' tier highlighted with a subtle 'Tracing Beam' or subtle inner glow.
layouts.footer: Massive structural footer with massive 'VAANI' text at the bottom. Clean links.

motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal using framer-motion (y: 100% to 0, overflow-hidden wrapper, staggered children).
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on use-case imagery and background elements using framer-motion useScroll and useTransform.
motion.micro_interactions: Buttons have hover scaling. Animated waveform/listening states in the voice demo (CSS scale-y keyframes).

Include data-testid on all interactive and key informational elements.
instructions_to_main_agent: Install dependencies: framer-motion, @studio-freight/react-lenis (or lenis), lucide-react, clsx, tailwind-merge.
Configure tailwind.config.js with the provided colors and font families (Cormorant Garamond, Manrope, JetBrains Mono). Add these fonts via Google Fonts in index.html.
DO NOT implement dark mode. The user explicitly requested 'NO DARK THEME'. Remove any dark mode classes or toggles.
Build the kinetic hero text reveal by splitting the H1 into lines, wrapping each in an overflow-hidden div, and animating the text upwards (y: 100% to 0) via framer-motion.
Implement the 'Voice Demo' mockup as an animated visual component. Use simple CSS animations (scaleY) to simulate a voice waveform.
The ROI Calculator must be fully functional. The formula is: (calls/day) * (missed% / 100) * (avg_value) * 30 days = Monthly Recovered Revenue. Example check: 80 * 0.28 * 450 * 30 = 302,400.
The pricing section must have an interactive billing toggle that dynamically updates the displayed prices.
Use 'clipped frames' for photography: wrap the image in a container with padding (e.g., p-4) and a 1px border to create an editorial passe-partout effect.
Do not use generic Shadcn cards for the main layout; use pure HTML/Tailwind to maintain the artistic 'Awwwards' feel with asymmetrical grids and deep spacing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling. Use grid-based asymmetry.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (e.g., p-12, p-16, py-32). Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, and custom selection states separate good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
